fact: Bank of Uganda officials told Parliament's COSASE on 2026-09-14 that the bank's oversight of wallet providers, payment firms and deposit-taking institutions rests on the National Payment Systems Act, 2020.

Bank of Uganda's payment systems director said on 2026-09-14 that the wallet providers it supervises and that it licenses are MTN and Airtel, non-bank mobile money operators, under the National Payment Systems Act, 2020.
